D: Four high school friends make a pact to change their lives before graduation.
P: Serve dessert when Jim's dad walks into the kitchen.
S: Crispy baked wings in hot butter sauce, blue cheese dip
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, served with a blue cheese dip and celery.
Dog Years cheese and gravy fries
the gang's hangout at the Dog Years diner

Thick-cut chips fried twice until crisp, piled with melting cheese curds or torn mozzarella and smothered in hot rich beef gravy. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, soak 30 minutes and dry well. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then at 190C until golden and crisp, and salt. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour until brown, whisk in 400ml beef stock and a dash of Worcestershire and simmer until thick. Pile the chips onto a platter, scatter with 200g torn fresh mozzarella and pour over the hot gravy.
Charred corn brushed with smoked paprika butter and lime
Corn cobs boiled, then charred on a hot grill and brushed with smoky paprika butter and fresh lime.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, slow cooked in foil until tender, then glazed with barbecue sauce over hot coals, with creamy coleslaw. Mix 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and half a tsp cayenne. Rub over 2kg pork ribs, wrap tightly in foil and bake at 150C for 3 hours. Unwrap, brush with 200ml barbecue sauce and cook over hot coals or under the grill for 10 minutes, basting, until sticky. Toss a quarter cabbage and a carrot, shredded, with mayonnaise and cider vinegar.
Prom night chicken parmesan and fries
Panko chicken under ham, tomato sauce and mozzarella, with fries and salad
Chicken parmigiana: crumbed breasts fried until golden, topped with napoli sauce, ham and mozzarella, grilled until bubbling, with chips and salad.
W: Lattice apple pie with cinnamon, served warm with ice cream
Granny Smith apples cooked with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, served warm with ice cream.
K: Espresso with hot chocolate milk, whipped cream and grated dark chocolate
Espresso stirred into cocoa and hot milk, frothed and topped with whipped cream and grated chocolate.

dishes.make_ahead: Wings can be dried a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and leave them uncovered in the fridge, ideally overnight. Season with salt.
Bake on a rack at 220C until crisp and golden.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the wings through it.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream for the dip. Serve with celery sticks.
Cut each cob into thirds and boil for 4 minutes. Drain well.
Char on a hot grill pan, turning, until blistered.
Melt the butter with the paprika and salt, brush over the corn and squeeze over the lime.

dishes.n: Prom night chicken parmesan and fries
dishes.make_ahead: Crumb up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: chicken breasts, halved through the middle

steps.text: Crumb the chicken in flour, egg then panko. Soak the cut chips in cold water, then dry well.
Fry the chips at a low heat until soft, drain, then fry again at a high heat until golden.
Shallow fry the chicken until golden and cooked through.
Top each piece with napoli sauce, ham and mozzarella and grill until bubbling. Serve with the chips and salad.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve warm

steps.text: Cook the apples with the butter, sugar and cinnamon until just soft. Cool.
Line a pie dish with 2 sheets of pastry and fill. Cut the other 2 sheets into strips and weave a lattice on top.
Bake at 190C until golden. Serve warm with ice cream.
Brew the coffee into four mugs, about one espresso each.
Heat the milk and whisk in the cocoa until frothy.
Pour the chocolate milk over the coffee and top with whipped cream and grated chocolate.

s.note: Crispy baked wings in hot butter sauce, blue cheese dip
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 60g butter. Mix 80g blue cheese into 150g sour cream to dip and serve with celery sticks.

s.note: Charred corn brushed with smoked paprika butter and lime
s.how: Cut 4 corn cobs into thirds and boil for 4 minutes. Drain, then char on a hot grill pan for 6 to 8 minutes, turning. Melt 60g butter with 1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of salt, brush over the corn and squeeze over 1 lime to serve.

m.n: Prom night chicken parmesan and fries
m.note: Panko chicken under ham, tomato sauce and mozzarella, with fries and salad
m.how: Halve 2 chicken breasts, crumb in flour, 2 eggs and 150g panko and fry until golden. Top with 250ml napoli sauce, 4 slices ham and 200g mozzarella and grill until bubbling. Fry 1kg potato chips twice and serve with a green salad.

w.note: Lattice apple pie with cinnamon, served warm with ice cream
w.how: Cook 1kg sliced green apples with 50g butter, 100g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 8 minutes and cool. Line a dish with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream.

d.note: Espresso with hot chocolate milk, whipped cream and grated dark chocolate
d.how: Brew 4 espressos with 72g ground coffee. Whisk 2 tbsp cocoa into 600ml hot milk until frothy. Pour the coffee into four mugs, top with the chocolate milk, whipped cream and grated dark chocolate.
